avis.titre: From someone who is actively against the skincare industry- buy it!
avis.texte: I gotta say this product is near-magic. Full disclosure: I started using it at the same time as using pure Cantella from Madagascar so they could be working in tandem. But I am normally so against buying skin trends, because the industry is so predatory, unnecessarily expensive and often times actually more damaging to the skin because of the amount of chemicals. Having said that, these two products were under $20 each which I’ll take and pretty big size. I’ve almost completely switched to an all-natural DYI skincare routine ie Castile soap and homemade creams to avoid these chemicals, and my skin became much happier, but wanted to add a product to achieve that glass skin effect that everyone loves. I’m actually a bit surprised with the results. I was worried it be like every other product- underwhelming if not more damaging. I’ve been using it morning and night for not even a week and what’s left of my black heads and mild discoloration has disappeared, and even more impressive, my skin looks more glassy, youthful, vibrant and glowing. I mostly always struggled with dull skin. My skin type is normal-oily and sensitive. I am also so happy that it didn’t irritate my skin, even though checking the ingredients it seems to contain a fair amount of chemicals, my skin can usually tell a cheap product right away because it will instantly turn red, which didn’t happen. Thank you! I guess Korean skincare is where it’s at.

The best toner I’ve ever used in a long time. It’s really light weight and it’s sits well even with just cream. But if you stack on other skin care items, it sits really but really nicely. It’s a watery toner texture, not a thick toner but a good hydrating one.

avis.titre: Gentle Exfoliating Toner for Beginners/Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: It’s not bad. I also use it as a second cleanse if I only use sunscreen for the day. It’s also a good everyday exfoliating toner because it’s gentle enough for daily use. A beginner exfoliant. Inexpensive for the size you get.

avis.titre: Every skin is different, this one was not for me
avis.texte: At first I liked this brand, I tried different products, but it's not worth it. I like to switch product for my skin as it can get used to one, but this was not for me, after using it like you should, I didn't see or feel what it is supposed to offer.

avis.titre: Favorite toner to use when prepping my skin for the rest of my routine!
avis.texte: I got a full size of this for free when ordering off olive young and I have kept it in my routine ever since. I've gone through multiple bottles. I've noticed clearer, healthier looking skin since ive been using it. I use it as the first toner in my routine and its a really nice base for the rest of my skincare. It has a thin watery consistency but feels really hydrating. I love this stuff.
Lo compré para mi hija y le a mejorado su rutina de cuidado de su rostro

avis.titre: Complicated, but seems promising for general skin health
avis.texte: Online, this toner touts a lot of good stuff for reducing black/white heads and controlling sebum production. On the package, I was able to translate (thanks to Google Lens) the Korean writing which stated that it was for whitening and wrinkles. Don't know which is the actual purpose of this toner, but I'll take any of it. I read through several other reviewers for this product, and many of them seem to have advanced knowledge in the skincare arena. I'm writing from a point of view of a person with average knowledge of skincare, so please bear with me. I thought toner was used to make the skin feel refreshed and "toned" for the application of other products and makeup. The first time I tried this toner, I was a little disappointed not to get that refreshed, taut skin feeling. My skin felt matte-fied, hydrated and stung just the tiniest bit. It wasn't bad, but I was confused as to what I was supposed to experience. That's when I went back online to read through the product information more carefully. From what I could find and understand, it strengthens and protects your skin's barrier that is weakened after cleansing, which is why this is good for sensitive skin. It also helps with sebum issues and I guess wrinkles and whitening (depending on what information is pertinent and accurate). Whatever the benefit may be, I do feel that this product has had some positive effects on my skin, though certain benefits won't be perceivable for a while. After using for several days and ni

After using this toner for over a few weeks, it's main purpose seems to hydrate and plump the skin after cleansing. While this does have ingredients to help with claims of reducing blemishes (tea tree) and controlling oil (niacinamide), I didn't noticed much more than hydration. That being said, it's nicely quenching and thin enough to layer onto the skin, if you're feeling particularly dry that day. It doesn't have any scent and feels only mildly calming. I like to use this by patting in with my hands and my skin drinks it right in. It doesn't have any tackiness and just leaves plump skin. Because it absorbs in quickly, I like to go in 2 to 3 more times before moving on to my serum. It works well for me day and night but for the price, it's pretty basic hydrating toner. Would recommend for sensitive skin since it's gentle, even on compromised skin.

Looks as advertised. Love it when the bottle is as big as the box it came it. Bottle came sealed. When you open the seal, you get a slight whiff of witch hazel but once you apply the toner on a cotton pad, it doesn’t smell like anything. Very lightweight and clean. The Korean description says it helps with skin lightening/brightening and improves wrinkles but there’s none of that listed in the English portion which is odd. Also, there’s no mention of being ideal for large pores, acne, etc. on the Korean description. Great as basic toner for sensitive skin. Docked a star for not having the same description in both languages and also another star for the price point. It’s a bit steep for a basic toner.

I’m a sucker for a good Korean toner and I’ve tried them all. This is a great toner for either a compromised barrier due to overuse of actives or overzealous Tretinoin/retinol use. If you have sensitive skin or have overused actives and caused damage and sensitivity, stop all actives and use gentle cleaner and a toner like this with only gentle and hydrating products until your barrier is healed. Continuing to acidify a damaged barrier can lead to big skin issues. This toner has no color or scent and is slightly viscous but watery. Use after cleanser and before any other products and don’t rinse off. Tea tree, cica, niacinamide, allantoin, propanediol, adenosine, ferments, rice water, hyaluronic acid, madecassoside-it goes on, these ingredients are the BEST of barrier soothing and reparative ingredients. It is also vegan and alcohol free. Note: some people are sensitive to niacinamide, this does contain it. Because this has so many ingredients it would be very tough to isolate which one you are sensitive to. I have dry sensitive sometimes acne prone skin and this works well with my skin. The bottle is a sturdy plastic with a quality flip top and you get a lot of product. Love.

avis.titre: I ride for Korean skincare, they get it right!
avis.texte: This toner is super light yet is has some slip to it, it's like the liquid that comes out when you slice an aloe leaf open, and I love it! It coats your skin lightly and gently moisturizes, keeping it damp and primed for your other products. The ingredient list is superb! It has Konjac root extract, witch hazel, papaya fruit extract, lactobacillus ferment... there are a lot of beautiful ingredients in this, many not common in US skincare! DO NOT use a cotton pad, you will only waste product. You just need to shake a few drops into your palm and apply directly to your face and neck. Toners are an easy way to up your skincare because a good toner can deliver great ingredients to your clean skin, while the pores are open and before you coat the skin with other products!

Really great facial toner! Alcohol and fragrance free! Leaves skin feeling soft and hydrated, without feeling oily or greasy! Absorbs quickly, skin feels instantly refreshed! Definitely my new favorite toner, highly recommend! Five stars!

I like how soft my face feels after I use this toner. It is very light and goes on almost like water, just a little thicker. I was very happy to see all the natural and clean ingredients in this bottle and I can feel the difference in my face. Another great Korean cosmetic product to add to my routine.

I have combination skin and this works great for me. Not scented at all. Feels good on my skin without leaving any residue. No redness or irrititation. I use after cleansing. I have noticed clear skin while using this. A little goes a long way so this bottle will last me a while.
